ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Macro-level ratio of approximately 70% low-intensity (black) to 30% high-intensity (white/gray) pixels, with high-intensity pixels localized primarily on the lateral lobes.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central region dominated by a contiguous low-intensity black mass. High-intensity white blobs are localized to the distal half of both lobes. The left lobe contains horizontal-linear low-intensity intrusions. The right lobe contains 3-4 distinct vertical high-contrast black streaks originating from the trailing edge.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Obtuse V-shaped depression with a calculated angle of approximately 105 degrees and a moderate bounding-box depth relative to the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular serration across the entire posterior boundary. Low-amplitude (1-5 pixel) variations in the medial sections, progressing to high-amplitude, jagged peaks at the distal tips, especially on the right-side terminal edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve along the posterior edges, tapering toward the terminal tips with a slight upward sweep on the lateral margins.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct clusters of high-contrast, textured pixel clusters localized at the extreme distal tips, particularly the right tip, indicative of surface colonization or dense scarring.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Horizontal linear pixel disruptions on the left lobe's white field and vertical, rake-like linear disruptions on the right lobe's white field.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular notch and textural distortion at the extreme right distal tip, consistent with physical trauma or heavy barnacle attachment.
other_distinctive_markers: Distinctive vertical 'tiger-stripe' pigmentation patterns on the right lateral lobe white patch.
